answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and files a pearl-sealed claim on one plot. Five random neighbors must walk the dune plot and sign a fresh pulse attestation in ten minutes. A neighbor vouching for a fake loses its bond, so rented neighbors fail; none attests twice. One fake costs 145: 70 plus five attestations at 15 each; 1,000 fakes cost 145,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 75 once and keep their bond.
